title: A shirt you have decided about

situation.en: You are looking at one blue T-shirt in the shop. You have decided what you want to do with it. Tell Drake what you would say.
situation.pcm: You dey look one blue T-shirt for shop. You don decide wetin you want do with am. Tell Drake wetin you go talk.
situation.en_pcm: You dey look one blue T-shirt for shop. You don decide wetin you want do with am. Tell Drake what you would say.

en: Please add one blue T-shirt to my basket.
pcm: Abeg put one blue T-shirt for my basket.
en_pcm: Abeg add one blue T-shirt for my basket.

title: A shirt you are still deciding about

situation.en: You like the blue T-shirt, but you are still deciding whether it should go into your basket. Tell Drake what you would say.
situation.pcm: You like di blue T-shirt, but you never decide if e suppose enter your basket. Tell Drake wetin you go talk.
situation.en_pcm: You like di blue T-shirt, but you never decide if e suppose enter your basket. Tell Drake what you would say.

en: I like the blue T-shirt, but please do not add it.
pcm: I like di blue T-shirt, but no put am for my basket.
en_pcm: I like di blue T-shirt, but no add am for my basket.

title: Looking for information about a shirt

situation.en: You are looking at the blue T-shirt and want to know more about it. Your basket already has items in it. Tell Drake what you would say.
situation.pcm: You dey look di blue T-shirt and you wan know more about am. Things dey already inside your basket. Tell Drake wetin you go talk.
situation.en_pcm: You dey look di blue T-shirt and you wan know more about am. Things dey already inside your basket. Tell Drake what you would say.

en: How much is the blue T-shirt? Please leave my basket as it is.
pcm: How much be blue T-shirt? No touch my basket oo.
en_pcm: How much be di blue T-shirt? No touch my basket oo.

title: Choosing between shirt colours

situation.en: The shop shows shirts in different colours. You want two shirts, but you have not chosen the colour yet. Tell Drake what you would say.
situation.pcm: Shop get shirts for different colours. You wan buy two, but you never choose colour. Tell Drake wetin you go talk.
situation.en_pcm: Shop get shirts for different colours. You wan buy two, but you never choose colour. Tell Drake what you would say.

en: Add two shirts, but I have not said which colour. Ask me first.
pcm: Put two shirts, but I never talk which colour. Ask me first.
en_pcm: Add two shirts, but I never talk which colour. Ask me first.

title: Deciding based on the price

situation.en: You are looking at the blue T-shirt. Its price is shown in the shop. You are deciding whether to buy one based on that price. Tell Drake what you would say.
situation.pcm: You dey look di blue T-shirt. Shop show di price. You dey decide if you go buy one based on di price. Tell Drake wetin you go talk.
situation.en_pcm: You dey look di blue T-shirt. Shop show di price. You dey decide if you go buy one based on di price. Tell Drake what you would say.

en: If the blue T-shirt is below twelve thousand naira, add one; otherwise do nothing.
pcm: If di blue T-shirt no pass twelve thousand naira, put one; if not, leave am.
en_pcm: If di blue T-shirt no pass ₦12,000, add one; if not, leave am.

title: Changing your mind about a waiting request

situation.en: You previously asked Drake about adding an item. Drake has not added it yet, and the request is still waiting. You have changed your mind. Tell Drake what you would say.
situation.pcm: You don ask Drake before to add something. Drake never add am and di request still dey wait. You don change your mind. Tell Drake wetin you go talk.
situation.en_pcm: You don ask Drake before to add something. Drake never add am and di request still dey wait. You don change your mind. Tell Drake what you would say.

en: Wait, cancel that addition. I do not want it added yet.
pcm: Wait oo, cancel am. I no want make e enter my basket yet.
en_pcm: Wait oo, cancel that addition. I no want make e enter my basket yet.
